name: TileButton
summary: A bare pressable tile (LR40): a button with no chrome of its own that fills its holder and holds what it shows (a picture, a swatch), for things chosen by their look on a grid: a cover's tiles, colour samples, thumbnails. Its corners are its holder's; the focus ring and the chosen ring sit inside its edge, so a grid with no gap never clips them. For an action with words use Button; for choosing pictures from a set use ImageGrid `selectable`.
a11y: A `button` named by `label` (its content is hidden from assistive technology), with `aria-pressed` when it is chosen. The focus ring is the library's, drawn inside the edge.

props.name: label
props.description: The tile's name, as a person would say it ("Harbour at dusk, columns 1 to 6, rows 1 to 4"). Its accessible name.

props.name: children
props.description: What the tile shows: a picture (`Image ratio="fill"`), a swatch, a thumbnail. Decorative to assistive technology.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Chosen (`aria-pressed`): an inset accent ring. Leave out for a tile that only acts.
